To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a chiral phosphorene nanotube can be synthesized from a zigzag phosphorous nanoribbon and an armchair phosphorus nanotube by molecular dynamics simulations.
a zigzag nanoribbon can be self assembled into a chiral nanotube around a template armchair nanotube and the process is thermodynamically favorable.

a zigzag nanoribbon can be self-assembled into a chiral nanotube with a template armchair nanotube, the self-assembly process is temperature dependent, the formed tube is thermodynamical stable, and chirality and measurement of the tube can be tuned by radius of the template tube and the ratio of the length of the ribbon to its width.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the self assembly of phosphorene nanotubes.
the synthesis of phosphorous nanostructures and the study of the properties of phosphorene nanotubes.
the controlled synthesis of phosphorus nanotube with predefined chirality by using molecular dynamics simulations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the self assembly process has a temperature dependence and size-effect, and that the chirality and measurements can be tuned by changing the diameter of the template tube and the width of the nanoribbon.
a self assembly process of zigzag phosphorenes can form a chiral nanotube surrounding an armchair phosphorene template nanotube.
the self assembly of chiral phosphorus tubes is feasible and controllable.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we can use molecular dynamics to predict the formation of chiral phosphorous tube from a zigzag phosphorous nanoribbon and an armchair template phosphorous tube.
we have demonstrated a novel and feasible route for controlled synthesis of PNTs and thus it is of great interest in semiconductor device applications.
we have shown a new method to synthesize phosphorous nanotubule by self assembly of phosphorene nanotube and the method can be controlled by the radius of tube and temperature.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a phosphorene nanotube can be self-assembled from a zigzag nanoribbon.
the self assembly of phosphorous nanoribbons to chiral tubes is feasible and controllable, and the synthesized tubes are thermodynamically stable.
the chirality and the diameter of a phosphorous nanotubule are tunable by the chirality and diameter of a template phosphorous nanotuble.
